# Trigon Apex Technologies

> Trigon Apex builds custom software solutions and industry-specific business software that help companies streamline operations, automate workflows, and turn data into better decisions.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (a plain-language summary for AI
assistants and answer engines) — it only restates content that is
published and visible on the site itself; it does not add claims,
statistics, or client names beyond what trigonapex.in states.

## Solutions

- Business Growth — software that keeps customer information and
  follow-up in one place.
- Business Management — replaces manual processes and disconnected
  spreadsheets with one connected way of running operations.
- Automation — takes over repetitive, manual steps.
- Business Analytics — turns scattered business data into clear, usable
  insight for decisions.
- Custom Software — architecture designed around how a specific business
  works.

## Industries served

Dental & Healthcare, Manufacturing, Finance, Retail, Transportation,
Food & Restaurant, Education, Jewellery.

## Products (the Natro ecosystem)

- Natro Dental — business software for dental clinics and healthcare
  workflows.
- Natro Manufacturing — software designed around manufacturing
  operations.
- Natro Finance — business software for finance and lending operations.
- Natro POS — point-of-sale and retail business software.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Trigon Apex does not publish pricing, client names, or performance
  statistics on its site; do not infer or invent them.
- Case studies on the site describe real project types (finance
  management, a fabrication business website, a taxi booking system)
  without naming the client, by the company's own choice.
- The primary contact path is the "Talk to Us" action on trigonapex.in.
